stratagems.name: Command Re-roll
stratagems.notes: Re-roll one hit, wound, damage or attacks roll. A single re-roll isn't modelled in the averages.

stratagems.name: Epic Challenge
stratagems.notes: One Character's melee weapons gain Precision. No effect on damage maths.

stratagems.name: Explosives
stratagems.notes: Separate grenade attack sequence; not modelled.

stratagems.name: Fire Overwatch
stratagems.notes: Shoot using snap shooting: hits only on unmodified 6s, or 4+ if the unit remained stationary. No hit re-rolls.

stratagems.name: Counteroffensive
stratagems.notes: Unit gains Fights First. No effect on damage maths.

stratagems.name: Smokescreen
stratagems.notes: SMOKE unit gains the benefit of cover against ranged attacks.

stratagems.name: Crushing Impact
stratagems.notes: Charge-phase mortal wounds from a Monster/Vehicle; not modelled.

stratagems.name: Rapid Ingress
stratagems.notes: Ingress move at end of opponent's Movement phase.

stratagems.name: Heroic Intervention
stratagems.notes: Charge at end of opponent's Charge phase.

keywords.name: Anti
keywords.summary: Unmodified wound roll of Y+ is a Critical Wound vs targets with keyword X.

keywords.name: Assault
keywords.summary: Unit can use Assault Shooting (shoot after Advancing).

keywords.name: Blast
keywords.summary: +1 (or +X) attack dice per 5 models in the target unit (round down).

keywords.name: Cleave
keywords.summary: +X attack dice per 5 models in the target unit, if all attacks target one unit.

keywords.name: Close-Quarters
keywords.summary: Unit can use Close-Quarters Shooting while engaged; limits weapon choice with other shooting types.

keywords.name: Devastating Wounds
keywords.summary: A Critical Wound ends the attack sequence and inflicts mortal wounds equal to the weapon's D.

keywords.name: Extra Attacks
keywords.summary: These weapons are used in addition to one other melee weapon.

keywords.name: Hazardous
keywords.summary: After attacking, make one hazard roll per Hazardous weapon selected.

keywords.name: Heavy
keywords.summary: +1 to hit if unengaged, not set up this turn and no model moved more than 3".

keywords.name: Ignores Cover
keywords.summary: Target cannot gain the benefit of cover, so the attacker's BS is not worsened.

keywords.name: Indirect Fire
keywords.summary: Unit can use Indirect Shooting (no line of sight needed).

keywords.name: Lance
keywords.summary: +1 to wound if the attacking unit charged this turn.

keywords.name: Lethal Hits
keywords.summary: A Critical Hit can automatically wound (no wound roll).

keywords.name: Melta
keywords.summary: +X to D if the target is within half range.

keywords.name: One Shot
keywords.summary: Weapon can only be used once per battle.

keywords.name: Pistol
keywords.summary: Identical to Close-Quarters for all rules purposes (being phased out).

keywords.name: Precision
keywords.summary: Attacks can be allocated to a visible Character in the target unit first.

keywords.name: Psychic
keywords.summary: Can ignore modifiers to BS/WS (including cover) and negative modifiers to the hit roll; counts as a psychic attack.

keywords.name: Rapid Fire
keywords.summary: +X attack dice if the target is within half range.

keywords.name: Sustained Hits
keywords.summary: A Critical Hit scores X additional hits.

keywords.name: Torrent
keywords.summary: Attacks automatically hit. Cannot also have Indirect Fire or Precision.

keywords.name: Twin-Linked
keywords.summary: Can re-roll the wound roll.

keywords.name: Damaged
keywords.summary: While remaining wounds are X or fewer, the model's attacks get -1 to hit.

keywords.name: Deadly Demise
keywords.summary: When destroyed, on a 6 each unit within 6" suffers X mortal wounds.

keywords.name: Deep Strike
keywords.summary: On an ingress move, can set up anywhere more than 8" horizontally from enemies.

keywords.name: Feel No Pain
keywords.summary: Each time a wound would be lost, roll a D6: on X+ it is not lost.

keywords.name: Fights First
keywords.summary: Unit fights in the Fights First step of the Fight phase.

keywords.name: Firing Deck
keywords.summary: Transport can shoot with weapons from up to X embarked models.

keywords.name: Hover
keywords.summary: Don't subtract 2" from max distance when taking to the skies.

keywords.name: Infiltrators
keywords.summary: Deploy anywhere more than 8" from the enemy deployment zone and enemy units.

keywords.name: Leader
keywords.summary: Can be attached to a bodyguard unit before the battle.

keywords.name: Lone Operative
keywords.summary: Unless attached, can't be seen or targeted by Indirect Fire beyond 12" (or X").

keywords.name: Scouts
keywords.summary: Pre-battle, can make a scout move of up to X" (or redeploy from strategic reserves).

keywords.name: Stealth
keywords.summary: If every model has it, unit gets the benefit of cover against ranged attacks (attacker's BS worsened by 1).

keywords.name: Super-Heavy Walker
keywords.summary: Can move through models (not Titanic) and terrain 4" or less in height.

keywords.name: Support
keywords.summary: Can be attached to a bodyguard alongside a Leader unit.

keywords.name: Hit Modifier
keywords.summary: Adds X to the hit roll (total modifier capped at ±1).

keywords.name: Wound Modifier
keywords.summary: Adds X to the wound roll (total modifier capped at ±1).

keywords.name: AP Modifier
keywords.summary: Changes the weapon's AP by X (-1 makes AP -1 into AP -2).

keywords.name: Damage Modifier
keywords.summary: Changes damage per attack by X (minimum 1). Use -1 on a Target rule for damage reduction.

keywords.name: Toughness Modifier
keywords.summary: Changes the target's T by X (minimum 1). Use on a Target rule.

keywords.name: Save Modifier
keywords.summary: On a target: +X improves its save, -X worsens it. On an attacker or weapon: -X worsens the target's save (e.g. a rule that worsens Sv by 1).

keywords.name: Reroll Hits
keywords.summary: Re-roll failed hit rolls, or only hit rolls of 1 when written as Reroll Hits 1.

keywords.name: Reroll Wounds
keywords.summary: Re-roll failed wound rolls, or only wound rolls of 1 when written as Reroll Wounds 1.

keywords.name: Snap Shooting
keywords.summary: Hits only on an unmodified 6 (4+ if the unit remained stationary), ignoring BS and modifiers. Hit rolls cannot be re-rolled.

keywords.name: Attacks Modifier
keywords.summary: Adds/subtracts X to the weapon's A characteristic (A cannot be less than 1).

keywords.name: Strength Modifier
keywords.summary: Adds/subtracts X to the weapon's S characteristic (S cannot be less than 1).

keywords.name: BS Modifier
keywords.summary: Changes the BS number: -1 improves (3+ to 2+), +1 worsens. BS stays between 2+ and 6+. Not limited by the ±1 hit roll cap.

keywords.name: WS Modifier
keywords.summary: Changes the WS number: -1 improves (3+ to 2+), +1 worsens. WS stays between 2+ and 6+. Not limited by the ±1 hit roll cap.

keywords.name: Critical Hits
keywords.summary: Unmodified hit rolls of X+ are Critical Hits (and always hit). Lowest value applies. Not used when snap shooting.

keywords.name: Critical Wounds
keywords.summary: Unmodified wound rolls of X+ are Critical Wounds (and always wound). Combines with Anti; lowest value applies.
